what: the league's seven SHOT_ZONE_BASIC regions read as a partition of the FLOOR. Both implementations of that partition - pipeline/common.py:zone_at and site/src/zone.ts:zoneAt - are checked against this file, so neither toolchain has to run the other's. Required agreement is 100%: this is parity between two copies of one rule, which is a different claim from the reconstruction's agreement with the league's own labels.
units: tenths of a foot, hoop at origin
